overview: Cameroon is a country in Central Africa, on the Gulf of Guinea, where West and Central Africa meet. Its capital is Yaoundé and its largest city is Douala. Cameroon was formed in 1960 and 1961 from former French and British territories, so both French and English are official languages. It is sometimes called 'Africa in miniature' because it has almost every kind of African landscape.

geography.text: Southern Cameroon is covered in rainforest, the centre is a high plateau, and the north is savanna reaching up to Lake Chad. Near the coast in the west, Mount Cameroon is an active volcano and one of the wettest places on Earth.
